name: Arcane Eye
summary: Creates an invisible floating eye that you can move and see through, with Darkvision.

stats.effect:
You create an {ref:condition/invisible}, invulnerable eye within range that hovers for the duration. You mentally receive visual information from the eye, which can see in every direction. It also has {ref:glossary/darkvision} with a range of 30 feet.

As a {ref:glossary/bonus-action}, you can move the eye up to 30 feet in any direction. A solid barrier blocks the eye's movement, but the eye can pass through an opening as small as 1 inch in diameter.
